meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开启高强度模式,让助手更专注彻底地完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在特定任务上切换到更专注、更彻底的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn on a high-intensity mode so the assistant finishes tasks more thoroughly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant in a more focused, thorough mode for a task

howto.what: 装上后，一旦你请求 ultrawork 模式，它会让 Claude 进入一种强约束流程：本轮第一行固定输出 `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`，用工具登记目标和成功标准，开一个只追加的便签记录，并通过真实界面跑出证据后才算完成。
howto.when: 只在你请求 ultrawork 模式、且该指令尚未出现在对话中时才读取本文件；若随 ulw-loop 指针或 ulw-execute 技能一起出现，由后者的契约接管目标与清单。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式修这个 bug
say.note: 首行会输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say.text: 以 ultrawork 模式实现分页接口，附 curl 证据
say.note: 会按 LIGHT/HEAVY 分级跑真实界面验证

say.text: ultrawork：把这次会话定为 HEAVY 并逐条验收
say.note: 会把分级理由和验收场景写进便签

howto.what_en: When you ask for ultrawork mode, Claude enters a binding mode: the first visible line is `ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!`, it registers a goal with success criteria, keeps an append-only notepad, and proves work on the real surface.
howto.when_en: Read only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation. A ulw-loop pointer or the ulw-execute skill supersedes the bootstrap sections.

say_en.text: Run ultrawork mode on this bug fix
say_en.note: First line will be ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!

say_en.text: In ultrawork mode, add the pagination endpoint with curl evidence
say_en.note: Runs real-surface proof sized to its tier

say_en.text: ultrawork: classify this session as HEAVY and verify each criterion
say_en.note: Records the tier reason in the notepad
